params.body:
On the "Omzet en aankoop" tab, the top-5 and top-10 shares were four sentences of plain text, one per year, flush against the table. You had to read four similar lines to compare years.

They are now a small panel, "Hoeveel de grootste klanten wegen, per jaar" (or leveranciers):
- one groove per year: dark for the five largest, light for the next five;
- the two percentages to the right;
- a legend and the note that the current year is still running.

The table and its note below get some space.

On a phone the percentages move under the bar.

Tests: `NetworkTest` assertions follow the new heading. Full suite 232/232. Checked in headless Chromium.
